pages.text: Ignition needs three things:$(li)a $(l:building/full_reactor)formed structure$()$(li)$(num)10,000$() mass in every stabilizer$(li)$(num)50,000,000 RF$() of charge in the core$(br2)Then press $(good)Ignite$() on the $(l:operation/control_console)console$().
If anything is missing, ignition fizzles and the console tells you why. A failed ignition costs nothing.$(br2)On success, the disc lifts and the reactor is $(good)Stable$().
pages.title: Fizzles
